instances.query:
I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into wrentiths. Here are the actions I can do

Maphile a block
Unwrentith a block from on top of another block
Diouet a block
Wrentith a block on top of another block

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only maphile or unwrentith one block at a time.
I can only maphile or unwrentith a block if my hand is empty.
I can only maphile a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not maphiled.
I can only unwrentith a block from on top of another block if the block I am unwrentithing was really on top of the other block.
I can only unwrentith a block from on top of another block if the block I am unwrentithing is clear.
Once I maphile or unwrentith a block, I am holding the block.
I can only diouet a block that I am holding.
I can only wrentith a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being wrentithed.
I can only wrentith a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am wrentithing the block is clear.
Once I diouet or wrentith a block, my hand becomes empty.
Once you wrentith a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

My goal is to have that the inatter block is on top of the magnatinte block.

(diouet b2)
